gloss_en: Nogah (kelipat Nogah) — the fourth, translucent 'glowing' husk of the kabbalistic kelipot (from Ezekiel 1:4, 'a radiance surrounding it'); the intermediate shell mixing good and evil that, unlike the three wholly impure husks, can be clarified and absorbed into holiness — locus of free choice and trial, linked to Chashmal, Targum, and the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil. Not the planet Venus, not generic 'brightness,' and not the verb נָגַהּ 'to shine.'
